title: Kinematic budget of quantum correlations
summary: The diversity of quantum correlations -- discord, entanglement, steering, and Bell nonlocality -- disappears at the kinematic level of observable second moments. By treating state purity as a finite resource, we introduce a local-unitary-invariant budget that splits these moments into local and nonlocal sectors. This maps quantum systems onto compact, two-dimensional manifolds whose topology is governed by purity and time-reversal symmetry.
